scope: Eight short same-machine release GUI benchmarks plus isolated idle CPU diagnostics; not first-paint, interactivity, long-duration or cross-platform acceptance
assessment: Initial two current 200-request p95 results were higher; two subsequent paired 1000-request comparisons did not reproduce a persistent directional regression. Short 5s CPU sample was higher for current; fixed 10s settle plus four 15s idle measurements yielded current2.948/2.974%, previous3.305/3.404% of one core. No performance improvement claim; limited tests do not establish long-duration repaint behavior.
